explanations.text: Combo draw: outs from both straight and flush draws combined (overlap removed).
Flush draw: 9 cards of that suit remain in the deck.
Open-ended straight draw: 4 cards on each end = 8 outs.
Gutshot straight draw: 1 rank completes it from each side = 4 outs.
Trips draw: pairing the board card rank to make trips.
Set draw: pairing your pocket pair into trips.
Two pair/full house outs: pairing your other hole card on a paired board.
Two pair/full house outs: pairing your other hole card on a paired board.

fallbackExplanation: Draw: {outs} outs based on visible cards.
